label: Basic Inline
description: Basic date selector. Best for the whole selector laid inline on a card with typed entry, and a JSON readout of the value under it.

label: Popover
description: Date selector in a sheet. Best for a field that opens the selector in a bottom sheet, with typed shortcuts and Cancel and Apply under it.

label: Dialog
description: Date selector in a dialog. Best for a dialog titled Select due date over a read only field, closing on Cancel or committing on Apply.

label: Language Menu
description: Date selector with a language menu. Best for a menu switching English, Spanish, French and German labels, day format and first weekday.
